frp.name: Fire Radiative Power
frp.description: Direct thermal radiation measured by satellite sensors indicating combustion intensity.

brightness.name: T4 Brightness Temperature
brightness.description: Peak middle-infrared (3.9 to 4.0 µm) channel brightness temperature.

bright_t31.name: T31 Background Temperature
bright_t31.description: Longwave thermal infrared (10.7 to 11.4 µm) background reference temperature.

thermal_contrast.name: Thermal Contrast (Delta T)
thermal_contrast.description: Sub-pixel combustion anomaly contrast calculated as T4 minus T31.

distance_to_industry_meters.name: Distance to Industrial Boundary
distance_to_industry_meters.description: Haversine distance from detection centroid to the nearest OpenStreetMap industrial boundary.

persistence_ratio.name: Temporal Persistence Ratio
persistence_ratio.description: Fraction of days with active thermal detections over the monitored observation window.

active_days_count.name: Active Detection Days
active_days_count.description: Number of distinct calendar days with thermal satellite detections in the cluster.

is_anomaly_spike.name: Thermal Anomaly Spike Indicator
is_anomaly_spike.description: Flag indicating if current FRP exceeds the cluster's historical median by 3.0×.

confidence_normalized.name: Normalized Detection Confidence
confidence_normalized.description: Satellite instrument confidence normalized to a uniform scale.
